snippet.title: How to PROPERLY Replace Shock Absorbers
snippet.description:
Learn how to replace shock absorbers in your car or truck. 

There are 2 main ways to tell if your shocks are bad:

1. When driving the vehicle is bouncing around and feels unsettled

2.  With a visual inspection you see dampness on the shock which is oil due to seals going bad. 

Then I show you how to replace the shock including the proper parts to lubricate to prevent squeaking and the easiest way to install the new shock. 

#ChrisFix

snippet.title: Deepam Order Row | SC Hands Madurai Hill Security To CRPF, Slams Tamil Nadu Govt Over Non-Compliance
snippet.description:
The Supreme Court on Friday directed the CRPF to take charge of security at the temple and the entire Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai, citing the Tamil Nadu Police's failure to implement its November 20 order on lighting the Deepam at the Deepathoon pillar. The court said the non-compliance prima facie amounted to contempt of court and wilful disobedience, and warned that such defiance could lead to constitutional chaos. It suspended the Uchipillaiyar temple's Board of Trustees, appointed two former High Court judges to oversee its administration, and asked the Chief Secretary to file an affidavit and appear personally at the next hearing. On November 24, the lamp was lit only at the customary location near the temple.

snippet.description:

0:01 Brake discs glow red under heavy braking
0:15 Dogs can pick up sticks
0:28 Low-end shops leave an orange-peel finish
0:59 Burnouts on sand make your wheels sink
1:14 Water slides actually work
1:34 Lucia’s gun from the prologue is still there
1:56 Balloons actually fly away when you cut the string
2:11 You can push stuck boats back into the water
2:31 Passing trucks can blow your hair around
2:47 Drawbridges open for you too
3:03 Street signs are surprisingly flexible
3:14 You can ask NPCs to pet their dogs
3:40 ATMs have privacy glass
3:56 Cars move out of the left lane to let faster traffic pass
4:15 Punching bags leave marks when hit
4:26 Partially damaged car lights start blinking
4:42 There is a speed feedback sign right before the Emerald Bridge
4:56 Hard crashes can damage your horn
5:13 Movement causes carbonated drinks to foam up and spill
5:34 Jason and Lucia put on and take off glasses when entering or leaving home
5:56 High beams automatically turn off for oncoming traffic
6:07 Raindrops appear on your clothes
6:18 You can steal money from NPCs' purses
6:35 Fingerprint smudges appear on phone screen
6:50 Fire extinguishers leave foam on the ground
7:01 Falling on grass leaves grass stains on your clothes
7:22 You can use trash bins
7:36 Jason locks the car with the key fob
7:47 Sandwich ingredients scatter when thrown
7:58 Side mirrors are foldable
8:06 Car seats adjust to each character
8:24 NPCs get angry when you crash into their cars and immediately confront you
8:52 Burnouts wear down your tires
9:09 You can annoy cops by honking at them
